confidence_notes: Ubud-specific October 2026 crowd-sourced prices support meals, regular cappuccino and domestic draft beer, but Numbeo flags the sample as limited (21 contributors in 18 months). A recent Ubud bar guide gives broad cocktail and wine ranges. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates; no live booking listings were consulted.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external city comparator used: food and drink use Ubud-specific published price data, while accommodation is a holistic estimate for a heavily touristed inland Bali destination.
